component.name: consul
component.title: Consul
component.description: Read, write and watch keys and events in Consul, and query or register its services, nodes, health checks and sessions.
component.label: cloud,api

connectTimeout.description: The connect timeout of the HTTP client. When not set, the default of the OkHttp client applies.

key.description: The key (kv) or event name (event) that the consumer watches or that the producer acts on; the other APIs do not use it. In a producer, a CamelConsulKey header overrides it, unless the header still holds the key that a consul consumer received (the CamelConsulReceivedKey exchange property).

pingInstance.description: Whether the Consul client pings the agent when it is created, so that creating it fails when the agent cannot be reached. The client is created when the consumer starts or when the producer handles its first message.

readTimeout.description: The read timeout of the HTTP client. When not set, the default of the OkHttp client applies; the Consul client extends it for the blocking queries of the consumers.

tags.description: Comma separated tags. The consul endpoints do not use this option, so setting it has no effect.

url.description: The URL of the Consul agent that the client connects to, such as http://localhost:8500 (the default of the Consul client when not set). Use an https URL to connect with sslContextParameters.

valueAsString.description: Whether the values of the kv API are decoded to text: the kv consumer then sets the decoded value as the body instead of the base64 encoded value, and the GET_VALUE and GET_VALUES actions return a String (a List of them) instead of Value objects. In a producer, the CamelConsulValueAsString header overrides it.

writeTimeout.description: The write timeout of the HTTP client. When not set, the default of the OkHttp client applies.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

action.label: producer
action.description: The default action. Can be overridden by CamelConsulAction. The actions depend on the API of the endpoint: agent has CHECKS, SERVICES, MEMBERS, AGENT, REGISTER and DEREGISTER; kv has PUT, GET_VALUE, GET_VALUES, GET_KEYS, GET_SESSIONS, DELETE_KEY, DELETE_KEYS, LOCK and UNLOCK; catalog has REGISTER, DEREGISTER, LIST_DATACENTERS, LIST_NODES, LIST_SERVICES, GET_SERVICE and GET_NODE; health has CHECKS, NODE_CHECKS, SERVICE_CHECKS and SERVICE_INSTANCES; session has CREATE, DESTROY, INFO, LIST and RENEW; preparedQuery has CREATE, GET and EXECUTE; event has FIRE and LIST; coordinates has DATACENTERS and NODES; status has LEADER and PEERS.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

configuration.label: advanced
configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints that this component creates. Each endpoint gets a copy, and the endpoint options override it.

consistencyMode.label: advanced
consistencyMode.description: The consistency mode of the catalog and health queries: DEFAULT (the leader answers), STALE (any server answers, possibly with outdated data) or CONSISTENT (the leader first checks with a quorum that it is still the leader). The CamelConsulConsistencyMode header overrides it.

consulClient.label: advanced
consulClient.description: The Consul client (org.kiwiproject.consul.Consul) to use instead of creating one. When set, the options that create the client (url, sslContextParameters, aclToken, userName, password, the timeouts and pingInstance) are not used.

datacenter.label: advanced
datacenter.description: The datacenter to query instead of the datacenter of the agent. Used by the catalog and health queries, the agent DEREGISTER action and the coordinates NODES action; the CamelConsulDatacenter header overrides it.

nearNode.label: advanced
nearNode.description: The name of a node (or _agent for the node of the agent) from which Consul sorts the results of the catalog and health queries by estimated round trip time. The CamelConsulNearNode header overrides it.

nodeMeta.label: advanced
nodeMeta.description: Comma separated node metadata filters, each as key:value, so that the catalog and health queries return only the nodes with that metadata. The CamelConsulNodeMeta header overrides it.

aclToken.label: security
aclToken.description: The ACL token that the client sends with each request to Consul, in the X-Consul-Token header. Not used when a consulClient is set: configure the token on that client instead.

password.label: security
password.description: The password for HTTP basic authentication to the Consul agent. Used only together with userName.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The SSL configuration of the HTTPS connection to the Consul agent. When not set, the global SSL context parameters are used if the component enables useGlobalSslContextParameters.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether to use the global SSL context parameters of the CamelContext for the endpoints that have no sslContextParameters.

userName.label: security
userName.description: The user name for HTTP basic authentication to the Consul agent. Used only together with password.

blockSeconds.label: consumer,watch
blockSeconds.description: The wait time in seconds of the blocking query with which the kv and event consumers watch: Consul answers when the data changes or when the time is up, and the consumer then queries again. The event consumer also waits this long before each query, and both wait this long (at least one second) before they query again after an error.

firstIndex.label: consumer,watch
firstIndex.description: The Consul index from which the first blocking query of the kv or event consumer waits for a change. With 0 the first query answers at once, so the consumer receives the current value of the key, or the events that Consul still keeps.

recursive.label: consumer,watch
recursive.description: Whether the kv consumer watches all the keys under the key (as a prefix) instead of only the key. When one of them changes, the consumer receives a message for each key under the prefix.

CamelConsulAction.label: producer
CamelConsulAction.description: The action to run, overriding the action option.

CamelConsulKey.description: The consumer sets the key of the value (kv) or the event name (event). In a producer, the key (kv) or event name (event) to act on, overriding the key option.

CamelConsulEventId.label: consumer
CamelConsulEventId.description: The id of the received event.

CamelConsulEventName.label: consumer
CamelConsulEventName.description: The name of the received event.

CamelConsulEventLTime.label: consumer
CamelConsulEventLTime.description: The Lamport time of the received event.

CamelConsulNodeFilter.label: consumer
CamelConsulNodeFilter.description: The node name filter (a regular expression) of the received event, when it has one.

CamelConsulTagFilter.label: consumer
CamelConsulTagFilter.description: The service tag filter (a regular expression) of the received event, when it has one.

CamelConsulSessionFilter.label: consumer
CamelConsulSessionFilter.description: The service name filter (a regular expression) of the received event, when it has one.

CamelConsulVersion.label: consumer
CamelConsulVersion.description: The version of the received event.

CamelConsulFlags.description: The flags of the value. The kv consumer sets the flags of the value it received, and the PUT action stores them with the value (default 0).

CamelConsulIndex.label: producer
CamelConsulIndex.description: The index from which a blocking catalog or health query waits for a change. These actions set it to the index of the answer.

CamelConsulWait.label: producer
CamelConsulWait.description: The maximum wait time of a blocking catalog or health query, such as 10s or 5m.

CamelConsulCreateIndex.label: consumer
CamelConsulCreateIndex.description: The index at which the key was created.

CamelConsulLockIndex.label: consumer
CamelConsulLockIndex.description: The number of times that a lock on the key was acquired.

CamelConsulModifyIndex.label: consumer
CamelConsulModifyIndex.description: The index at which the key was last modified.

CamelConsulOptions.description: The options of the request, as an object of org.kiwiproject.consul.option: PutOptions for PUT, QueryOptions for GET_VALUE, GET_VALUES and the event LIST, and EventOptions for FIRE.

CamelConsulResult.description: Whether the action had a result: false when nothing was found, else the outcome of PUT, LOCK and UNLOCK, and true for the other actions. The consumers set it to true.

CamelConsulSession.description: The id of the session. The kv consumer sets the session that holds the lock on the key. LOCK and UNLOCK use it, and DESTROY, INFO and RENEW of session read it before the body.

CamelConsulValueAsString.label: producer
CamelConsulValueAsString.description: Whether GET_VALUE and GET_VALUES return the values decoded to text, overriding the valueAsString option.

CamelConsulNode.label: producer
CamelConsulNode.description: The node name for the GET_NODE action of catalog and the NODE_CHECKS action of health.

CamelConsulService.label: producer
CamelConsulService.description: The service name for the GET_SERVICE action of catalog and the SERVICE_CHECKS and SERVICE_INSTANCES actions of health.

CamelConsulDatacenter.label: producer
CamelConsulDatacenter.description: The datacenter to query, overriding the datacenter option. The session actions use only this header.

CamelConsulNearNode.label: producer
CamelConsulNearNode.description: The node from which Consul sorts the results of the catalog and health queries by round trip time, overriding the nearNode option.

CamelConsulNodeMeta.label: producer
CamelConsulNodeMeta.description: The node metadata filters, each as key:value, of the catalog and health queries, overriding the nodeMeta option.

CamelConsulLastContact.label: producer
CamelConsulLastContact.description: The time in milliseconds since the server that answered a catalog or health query last had contact with the leader.

CamelConsulKnownLeader.label: producer
CamelConsulKnownLeader.description: Whether the server that answered a catalog or health query knew the leader.

CamelConsulConsistencyMode.label: producer
CamelConsulConsistencyMode.description: The consistency mode of the catalog and health queries, overriding the consistencyMode option.

CamelConsulHealthyOnly.label: producer
CamelConsulHealthyOnly.description: Whether the SERVICE_INSTANCES action returns only the instances that pass all their health checks.

CamelConsulHealthyState.label: producer
CamelConsulHealthyState.description: The state of the health checks that the CHECKS action of health returns. Required for that action.

CamelConsulPreparedQueryID.label: producer
CamelConsulPreparedQueryID.description: The id of the prepared query for GET and EXECUTE. When not set, the body holds the id.

CamelConsulServiceId.label: producer
CamelConsulServiceId.description: The id of the service that the DEREGISTER action of agent removes. Required for that action.

consumerOut.description: The kv consumer: the value of the key (of each key under it with recursive) base64 encoded as Consul stores it, decoded with valueAsString=true, with the key, flags and indexes in headers; null for a key without value. The event consumer: the payload of the event as text, with its name and id in headers

producerIn.description: PUT and LOCK store the body converted to text as the value, and FIRE sends it as the payload (an event without payload for a null body): a Map or a POJO is stored as its toString, so marshal it first. REGISTER, DEREGISTER of catalog and CREATE take the model object of the Consul client, such as a Registration or a Session; the session and prepared query actions read the id from the body when its header is not set; the other actions take their input from headers

producerOut.description: The response of Consul as the model objects of the Consul client: a List or a Map of them for the list actions, the Value of the key for GET_VALUE (its value base64 encoded) or the value as text with valueAsString=true, and the Event for FIRE. Unchanged for the actions that only write (PUT, the deletes, LOCK, UNLOCK, REGISTER, DEREGISTER, DESTROY) and when nothing is found, with the outcome in the CamelConsulResult header

apiEndpoint.description: The Consul API to use: kv, event, agent, catalog, health, session, preparedQuery, coordinates or status. Only kv and event have a consumer, the others only a producer; any other value is used as kv.

exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.
